item.description: ### Added - **Answer permissions from the iPhone notification.** When an agent asks to run a tool, the phone alert now carries Allow and Deny buttons. Allow asks for Face ID / passcode first — approving a tool from a locked screen should cost that much — then the app opens, connects to your Mac, and delivers the decision, confirming on screen. If the Mac can't be reached or the window already closed, it says so plainly instead of pretending. Questions and plans keep the plain alert: those need reading, not a button. Needs the companion app 1.0.6 or later.
